content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Netflix Fans Live Here's PostNetflix Fans Live Here2d · Shared with PublicDan Levy is back on TV for the first time since Schitt's Creek ended in 2020, and BIG MISTAKES is already proving the six-year wait was worth it. The new Netflix crime comedy debuted on April 9 and shot straight to #2 in the US within its first two days, landing a near-perfect 95% on Rotten Tomatoes in the process.Levy plays Nicky, an uptight gay pastor who gets blackmailed into organized crime alongside his chaotic sister Morgan, played by Taylor Ortega. But the scene-stealer everyone is talking about is Laurie Metcalf as their unhinged matriarch Linda, with critics already calling her performance the best thing on Netflix right now.
